candidates.change_summary: Replace update order: call Log.AddMessage before updating balances so the logged value differs and balances update still happens after logging.
Remove the balances increment so deposits do not change stored balances (observable difference after Deposit).
Double the increment so balances increase by twice msg.value (changes balances observed after Deposit).
Use subtraction instead of addition so Deposit decreases the sender's stored balance by msg.value.
Insert an extra write setting another address's balance (address(0)) to msg.value, altering balances at a key possibly chosen by checker.
Move the require to after balances update so overflow/underflow check happens too late and may allow state change to occur before reverting (observable difference).
